summary: LA County forestry lookout built 1925 on Castro Peak; out of service 1971, cab moved to Henninger Flats about 1978 and dismantled in 2025; Fairplex re-erection is only an announced intent.

facts.design: 8 by 8 foot metal cab on a 22-foot tower
facts.status_note: Tower went out of service in 1971. The cab moved to the Henninger Flats Forestry Unit about 1978 and was dismantled by LA County Fire in 2025. No source confirms that re-erection at Fairplex has happened.

staffing.status: Operated by the LA County Forestry Department until service ended in 1971; no later staffing described

access.note: Original peak listed as 'Private Property, no access' by one regional lookout list. The Henninger Flats public education display was dismantled in 2025, so the cab is not on view.

visit.trail_note: The peak is listed as private property, so there is no public visit route to the original site. No public display of the cab exists since the 2025 dismantling.

facts.agency: Los Angeles County Fire Department, Forestry Division (NHLR administrator); built and first operated by the Los Angeles County Forestry Department

events.note: Built by the Los Angeles County Forestry Department on Castro Peak
Went out of service; no last staffing date given
Moved to the LA County Fire Henninger Flats Forestry Unit, approximately 1978 per FFLOS; refurbished and set up as a public education display
Registered December 8, 2018 as NHLR US 1289, CA 127
Peak site registered February 26, 2020 as FFLOS US 1928, CA 108
Cab dismantled by LA County Fire Department at Henninger Flats; intent to erect at LA County Fairgrounds (Fairplex, Pomona) is unconfirmed

corrections.why: The cab was moved to Henninger Flats and was not destroyed. The FFLOS 'Removed' field refers to the tower leaving the peak.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief's conflict list shows ffla_groups as standing. Sources from 2025 say the Henninger Flats cab was dismantled, and no source found says the cab stands today.
FFLOS gives 862 m for the original peak site. NHLR and Wikipedia give 778 m for the Henninger Flats location. Each is correct for its own site.

notes_for_editor: The 2025 dismantling is reported by FFLOS and Wikipedia. The Fairplex re-erection is stated only as an intention, so do not describe it as done. The brief's events list omits the 2018 NHLR registration and the 2025 dismantling; both are added here. The Johnstone Peak precedent at Fairplex came from a search result only and is not used. Wikipedia is used as a lead and its claims are matched to the NHLR and FFLOS pages it cites.
